title: Transition Foundation Controller trust anchor
why_now: DTF-CC007-001 approved a MacBook-originated one-shot remote record-controller call, but the existing Foundation has no trust anchor that a Mac mini invocation cannot replace. Read-only inspection confirms the dedicated SSH key works, while the current Mac mini authorized_keys entry has no forced-command/restrict options and the proposed root-owned trust-anchor path is absent.
prompt: 是否批准推荐的 dedicated signing trust anchor：Mode Activation 在 MacBook 创建仅 Controller host 可读的 Ed25519 signing private key，并在 Mac mini /private/etc/juanerai/controller-trust.json 安装 root-owned 只读 public trust record；Foundation 只读取该固定路径并验证 canonical ControllerInvocationV1 签名？

options.label: 批准根信任锚
options.description: 推荐。私钥仅留在 MacBook host，Mac mini 只持有 root-owned 公钥记录；不新增 dependency/public method，Mode Activation 才执行安装、权限与真实远程 canary。

options.label: 仅信任 SSH
options.description: 把现有 SSH 会话和 runtime.device 当作来源证据，不做应用层签名；本地 Mac mini 进程可伪造 Controller 调用，需明确风险豁免。

options.label: 停止本次切换
options.description: 保持当前 main 和旧模式；不为双端 Controller 调用增加主机级 trust anchor。

cli_instruction: 正式决定请回复：批准 DTF-CC008-001 A；如接受弱化认证，请回复批准 DTF-CC008-001 B；如停止，请回复停止本次模式切换。
resolution_summary: 用户批准选项 A：Mode Activation 在 MacBook 创建专用 Ed25519 signing private key，并在 Mac mini /private/etc/juanerai/controller-trust.json 安装 root-owned 只读 public trust record；Foundation 只冻结固定路径读取、canonical invocation 和验签协议。
